description: AI-generated beer label, warning on a white strip; the model printed "impairs' ability"

observations.bottler_name: Brewed and Canned by Harbor Light Brewing Co.
observations.warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs' ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.

rules_verdict_why: The misspellings sit within two letters of the statute's words or drop one word, which the rules cannot tell from a misread. They refer the label with every difference listed, so an agent rejects it; they never pass it.
